result.text:
## Visual Facts — Post ID: product-poster

**isLikelyScreenshot:** false

---

### Text (verbatim)
> **MIRA STUDIO**
> **NEW DROP**
> LINEN SET / 12 JUN
> SAGE + IVORY

---

### Scene & Composition
- Square-format graphic/poster with a warm off-white (cream) outer background and a white rounded-rectangle card in the centre.
- Minimalist, flat-design aesthetic — no photography, only geometric shapes used as colour swatches or abstract product stand-ins.

### Graphic Elements
- **Left shape:** Large soft sage-green oval/pill shape — likely representing the "Sage" colourway.
- **Right shape:** Dark near-black rounded rectangle with a dark circle overlapping its top-right corner — likely representing the "Ivory" or dark colourway contrast element (or a stylised product silhouette).

### Brand / Product Cues
- Brand name: **MIRA STUDIO** (bold, top-left of card).
- Product announced: **Linen Set** in colourways **Sage + Ivory**, dropping **12 June**.
- Palette used in the poster: sage green, near-black/dark brown, cream/ivory — consistent with the stated calm, neutral colour story.
